title: Cold-start understanding should ask before pretending certainty
comparison_focus: Sparkle should expose missing information and ask the highest-value first question instead of hallucinating a full plan.
expected_clarification_hint: Which subject matters most right now?

title: 14-day exam planning should recognize pressure and continuity
comparison_focus: Sparkle should combine exam pressure, recent wins, and schedule fit instead of producing a generic sprint.

title: Continuity understanding should preserve stable patterns and recent changes
comparison_focus: Sparkle should keep stable work-style signals while still surfacing fresh pain points and corrections.

title: Trust and recognition should show claims, predictions, and calibration
comparison_focus: Sparkle should let the user see what it believes, how confident it is, and what is still uncertain.
